final_checkpoint_locator: The commit introducing this readiness-decision.json on the assessment branch is R4. Resolve its full SHA from Git and verify against the live remote after push; no recursive self-SHA is embedded.
basis: The accepted six-family implementation has no demonstrated unresolved engineering/compatibility defect requiring correction before architectural progression.
Stage framework and Magic/Holy Q/RD/RA production are complete and locked. Native source identity, eligible contribution isolation, defenses and resource channels remain authoritative.
Soul, Elemental and Energy causal questions are closed without production fixes. Their PASS results do not establish comprehensive endgame balance.

Current native Severance remains mechanically valid but severely endgame-limited against accepted Regenerate profiles. Rejected/exhausted Candidate C is not current production or an available promised remedy.
Accepted artifacts are sufficient and consistent once explicit supersessions and test scope are respected. No new combat experiment was necessary.
Owner acceptance of the remaining Severance design tradeoff is not inferred merely from acceptance of the research's factual conclusions.

owner_decisions.decision_required: Accept current mechanically valid native/production Severance, including its severe Regenerate-limited sustained endgame progress, as the baseline for original Phase 7 without requiring another Severance architecture or practical strongest-boss kill guarantee first.
owner_decisions.why_owner: Evidence proves the limitation, not whether it is acceptable for the intended design. Weakness under native counters is not an engineering defect. Candidate C remains rejected/exhausted and cannot be treated as an unfinished production fix.
owner_decisions.if_accepted: Current native/production Severance stays unchanged and its endgame limitation remains documented. Candidate C stays rejected; no further Severance architecture is required before Phase 7. Future design work requires separate owner authorization. Owner must still explicitly authorize original Phase 7 and its scope.
owner_decisions.if_not_accepted: Pause architectural progression for an owner-defined design requirement and separately authorized bounded task. Do not infer approval for Candidate D, RW calibration, Regenerate redesign, global buffs or reopening Candidate C.

remaining_limits: Full sustained Soul/Elemental/Energy gameplay balance, all bosses, every defense/equipment combination, multi-core Elemental and human-client multiplayer are not established by native-path research.
Magic/Holy accepted damage-side calibration does not erase native healing or guarantee practical sustained boss kills.
Matching Magic/Holy Nullification, Soul Spiritual Nullification/death and other unselected native gates have source/focused-test coverage, not complete runtime coverage.
Original 6F/APO runtime acceptance is retained as documentation; temporary raw captures were not retained. No fresh all-affix runtime claim is made.
Energy's old 269 absent operations remain individually unassigned by direct timer evidence; the fixture mechanism is structurally explained and newly reproduced in five failures.
Soul's original Hinata flight miss, reconstructed NEB recovery caller and Elemental's retained Fire Resistance origin remain documented narrow evidence limits, with the native-path questions closed.
Conditional multi-hour HP projections are not observed kills; HP/SHP/MP/AP/wound are not combined into a fabricated common damage metric.
closed_findings: Stage framework and Magic/Holy production complete/locked; no recalibration.
Severance admission reliability corrected by R5; native wound and Regenerate state/dynamic authority established.
Candidate C: CANDIDATE_C_REJECTED / REJECTED_EXHAUSTED; no RW calibration, production implementation or automatic replacement architecture.
exact_next_task: Owner reviews the pushed six-family assessment and resolves OD1_SEVERANCE_PHASE7_BASELINE. Only after acceptance and separate explicit authorization should original Phase 7 scope be confirmed and work begin. Stop now; no new family, balance program or architecture is started.
